Sources, assumptions and verification.

The synthetic container lab is validated. Technical extension points on this page remain proposals unless explicitly identified as implemented. Understand the labels.

Start with inspectable evidence

Container acceptance report: executed real SQL/OPA placement, migration, restart, telemetry and live browser gates. Testing guide: commands and the distinction between container acceptance, source tests and browser models. Decision register: choices, alternatives and pilot gates.

Synthetic assumptions are not bank policy

All entity names, country allocations, local-only rules and hub mappings are examples. The four stores run on one host. Country labels do not prove physical residency. Browser model results and historical SQLite unit tests do not establish CockroachDB behaviour.
